name: Answer Me
source:
Dealing with zombies are already enough!! Or is it?

Now you're also trapped with a crazy stalker-kidnapper guy... Just great.

Answer his questions the way he likes it or face the consequences. There shouldn't be a right or wrong answer to everything he asks, but you wouldn't wanna know what punishment he would give you, right?

[From [url=https://milina-bryce.itch.io/answer-me]Itch.io[/url]]
